I saved the draft mail to Hollis and replied to Anselm in his DM to say so.

- **Draft:** It's addressed to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com), who is internal. The subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate of $2,101 a seat as Marcus provided it, says Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to check with Anselm or June before passing it on. Nothing has been sent; it waits for someone to send it.
- **Approval:** No approval request was needed. Anselm is CFO, so he can approve sharing this rate himself, and he did that in this conversation. Hollis's address is on pemberline.com, so Ruth Calloway's sign-off for outside mail didn't apply.
- **Not checked:** I used the $2,101 figure exactly as Anselm gave it. I didn't check it against Marcus's original message or any Thornbury records, and I didn't look anywhere outside this DM.
